sources.verified_angle_summary: Taiwan Excellence is making its inaugural appearance at LEAP 2026 with a dedicated pavilion themed 'Taiwan AI Island,' bringing 22 award-winning technology brands to Riyadh. Instead of a generic delegation overview, this angle focuses on the specific hardware and infrastructure capabilities being showcased across AI computing, industrial edge AI, and smart mobility. The pavilion features major manufacturers including ASUS, Pegatron, Advantech, and MSI, demonstrating advanced solutions like AI servers, liquid cooling, and edge computing systems. The presence of these 22 companies highlights Taiwan's strategic alignment with Saudi Vision 2030, positioning Taiwanese ICT manufacturing as the foundational hardware layer powering global AI deployment and smart city infrastructure in the Middle East.
sources.verified_key_facts: Taiwan Excellence is making its first-ever appearance at LEAP 2026; The pavilion features 22 award-winning Taiwanese brands; The exhibition is themed 'Taiwan AI Island' with the slogan 'If AI drives the future, Taiwan powers it'; Key participating companies include ASUS, Pegatron, Advantech, MSI, and Lanner Electronics; The showcase covers AI computing, industrial edge AI, smart mobility, and digital living; Featured technologies include advanced AI servers, liquid cooling, edge AI computing, and EV charging; A dedicated product launch event 'LEAP into the Future' is scheduled for August 31, 2026, at Hall 5, Booth F50; The participation is organized by Taiwan's Bureau of Foreign Trade and implemented by TAITRA.
